learning_outcomes.text: Students learn the basics of mechanical modeling, methods for analyzing forces acting on and within mechanically stressed components, and acquire an understanding of the structure of statically determinate supporting structures with the goal of designing and analyzing load-bearing constructions and machine components.
Students have the competence to independently analyze, calculate, and evaluate the static stress on components. They can apply the learned knowledge to practical tasks.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, use of Technical Mechanics, fields of application
Fundamentals and axioms of statics, vector calculus, concept of force, moment
Central, non-central force system, equilibrium conditions
Truss structures: static determinacy, member forces
Beam structures: supports, support reactions, Gerber beams, three-hinged arches, internal forces and moments, concentrated forces and distributed loads, frames and arch girders
Adhesion and friction, screw and rope friction
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module examination.
